Citation: Fallou Ngom (PI), Jennifer Yanco,  Mustapha Hashim Kurfi, Garba Zakari, Babacar Dieng, Daivi Rodima-Taylor, and Rebecca Shereikis. 
2022. “A Poem in Honor of the Emir of Kano.” http://sites.bu.edu/nehajami/the-four-languages/hausa/hausa-manuscripts/falke-2729-wakar-sarkin-
kano/. 

 

 
 
 
               
              
 
         1 
 

Waƙar Sarkin Kano  

Wa bi nastaʿīnu  

Amīru Kano atana yauma sabtin  

Atana Alimun 

Sarkinmu Abdullahi ya zo Asabat 
 
Ya bar Kano ranar Alhamis ba shakka 

Muna gaisuwa albarkacinka muke da 
 
Murna mukai mun marhaban da zuwanka 

Sarkin Musulmi ya wuce ya yi sabaqa 
 
Mai gandu na bi duk ana dubinka 

Wannan tawali’u ne da Allah yai maka  
Ladabi ya baka da martabar kakanka 

Ya Abdu ya ɗan Abdu me kyan Abdu kai 
Ka kai fagen da ake bukatar saninka 

Allah Yakaika Yamaida kai da farin ciki Birnin  Kano ta yi marhabin da zuwanka 

Birni tana gorantaka tufar da kai 
 
Allah Yakaika gidanka domin Makkah 

Bana Ingilan ta yi arziƙi da ka je mata  
Fa sarauniya ta tashi don girmanka 

Manyan nasaran Britin da birninsu 
 
Har jami’ansu da nufin zuwa kallonka 

Wannan karama ce da Allah yai maka  
Ya fawwala makhlūqāti duk sun bi ka 

In khāliqi ya so mutum da farin ciki 
 
Fa wurin halitta duk yake haɗa maka
